reason: The README clearly describes a Chrome-Dino-style interactive game embedded in the DeepSeek Harness Web input area, with configurable gameplay and local avatar management, so navigation-panels is the closest primary category.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入区域中添加一个可配置的梁大快跑小游戏面板，并支持本地头像选择与上传。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable Liangda Runner mini-game panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web input area with local avatar selection and upload support.

capabilities: Adds an interactive mini-game panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web interface
Stores game state in browser localStorage
Lists, serves, and uploads avatar image files through a local plugin webServer route
Provides plugin configuration settings for gameplay and avatar selection
